answer: Invitations form a quota tree with branching factor eight, so one parent admits eight children and then its slot closes for good. Every invitee holds a signed relic from its parent, re-checked by a second panel three epochs later, and a rejected branch debits the whole spine above it. Unused slots halve each silent epoch, so idling bleeds standing instead of parking it. Ten thousand farm accounts need 1,375 parents, each carrying a plume of quota debt and leaving an empty harbor where attested work should be.
